name: Narayanan Krishnan
review:
To,
The Management,
Jupiter hospital
Appreciation for the Care and Support Extended to My Wife, Mrs. Rajeswari Narayanan, IP No.266927, MR No.749767, Bed No.524.
I am writing to convey my sincere gratitude and appreciation to the entire team of Jupiter Hospital, Thane, for the excellent medical care and support extended to my wife, Mrs. Rajeswari Narayanan, who was admitted on 10th September 2025 with fever, abdominal pain, and multiple infections including kidney-related infections. She is still undergoing treatment, and throughout this period we have consistently experienced professionalism, empathy, and compassion across all levels of your staff.

From the janitorial and security teams, who ensure a safe and clean environment, to the pantry staff, especially Mr. Shantaram Rathod, nursing staff, and doctors, every individual has contributed meaningfully to her care. Their collective efforts have not only aided in her treatment but also provided us comfort and reassurance as a family.

I would like to specially acknowledge:

Dr. Snehal Tanna, who has been treating my wife since August 2024 for diabetes and other health issues. His consistent care, medical expertise, patience, compassionate approach / guidance have played a vital role in her recovery journey & have also been invaluable to her ongoing care.

Ms. Nithya Nair, who assists Dr. Tanna, has been approachable, patient-friendly, and supportive. Her good attitude, willingness to guide patients in understanding the treatment, and receptive mindset have greatly helped us during this period.

Mr. Sachin Bagkar, Floor Manager, whose attentiveness and responsiveness in addressing operational matters and my personal concerns with patience reflect professionalism of the highest standard.

Dr. Prerna Juneja, Clinical Head, who took the time off to meticulously understand and resolve the issues I raised with care and clarity, reflecting her leadership and deep commitment to patient care.

The coordinated teamwork and dedication displayed by every member of your hospital staff embody the values of Jupiter Hospital and reinforce our confidence in your institution. It is heartening to witness an organization where every role, from support services to clinical leadership, contributes with such sincerity to the well-being of patients.

On behalf of my wife and family, I extend our heartfelt thanks to all of you for your tireless service, kindness, and excellence in healthcare. Your efforts have made a challenging situation far more bearable for us, and we remain deeply grateful.

With warm regards and appreciation,
Advocate K.A.Narayanan & the patient, Mrs. Rajeswari Narayanan, M.A., LL.B

review:
Highly recommend Jupiter Hospital and their dedicated doctors!
My dad was facing difficulty in swallowing, and I first contacted the hospital. He had a history of cancer. The call was transferred to the Endoscopy Department, where I spoke with Dr. Sunil Singh for the first time. He was extremely calm and patient. He immediately asked us to come to the hospital and guided us very well.
All the staff members at the hospital were polite and helpful, which made us feel comfortable even during such a stressful time. Dr. Sunil listened carefully to our concerns, understood the case history, and advised us to do the necessary tests for reassurance. He even coordinated with Dr. Ravindra and helped us get an appointment right away.
Dr. Ravindra explained us everything in detail. He performed the endoscopy and shared the report with complete clarity.
The support and care we received from the doctors and the hospital staff was excellent. I truly appreciate their professionalism, patience, and compassion.
